# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated during the assessment workflow.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Dependency categories, version observations, and test dependency inventory.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint contracts, communication patterns, and sequence flow.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, entity relationships, and data ownership boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, properties, and runtime settings inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core domain workflows, service mapping, and workflow decision sequence.
